title: Zechariah Chapter 6 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Zechariah chapter 6 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Zechariah Chapter 6 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Zechariah Chapter 6.

questions.question: What did Zechariah see coming out from between two mountains?
questions.explanation: Zechariah saw four chariots coming out from between two mountains, as stated in Zechariah 6:1.

questions.question: What were the mountains made of from which the chariots came out?
questions.explanation: The mountains were described as mountains of brass in Zechariah 6:1.

questions.question: What color were the horses in the first chariot?
questions.explanation: The first chariot had red horses, according to Zechariah 6:2.

questions.question: Which color horses were in the second chariot?
questions.explanation: The second chariot had black horses, as stated in Zechariah 6:2.

questions.question: What colors were the horses in the third and fourth chariots, respectively?
questions.explanation: The third chariot had white horses and the fourth had grisled and bay horses according to Zechariah 6:3.

questions.question: Who did Zechariah speak to when he asked about the chariots?
options: The angel that talked with him
questions.correctAnswer: The angel that talked with him
questions.explanation: Zechariah asked the angel that talked with him about the chariots, as in Zechariah 6:4.

questions.question: What did the angel say the four chariots represented?
options: The four spirits of the heavens
The four horsemen of the apocalypse
The four corners of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: The four spirits of the heavens
questions.explanation: The angel explained that the chariots were the four spirits of the heavens in Zechariah 6:5.

questions.question: From whom do these four spirits go forth?
options: From standing before the Lord of all the earth
From the east and the west
questions.correctAnswer: From standing before the Lord of all the earth
questions.explanation: The four spirits go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth as stated in Zechariah 6:5.

questions.question: True or False: The black horses went forth into the south country.
questions.explanation: The black horses went forth into the north country, not the south, according to Zechariah 6:6.

questions.question: True or False: The white horses went forth after the black horses.
questions.explanation: The white horses went forth after the black horses as described in Zechariah 6:6.

questions.question: The bay horses sought to go in what manner through the earth?
questions.explanation: The bay horses sought to walk to and fro through the earth, as stated in Zechariah 6:7.

questions.question: Who did the LORD command to make crowns and set them upon Joshua's head?
questions.explanation: The LORD commanded to take silver and gold from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah to make crowns for Joshua, as in Zechariah 6:10-11.

questions.question: What title is given to Joshua the son of Josedech in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Joshua is called The Branch, who shall build the temple of the LORD, according to Zechariah 6:12.

questions.question: True or False: The Branch will be only a priest and not a ruler.
questions.explanation: The Branch shall both sit and rule upon his throne and be a priest upon his throne, as stated in Zechariah 6:13.

questions.question: In Zechariah 6, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: Take silver and gold to make crowns
Look and see the four chariots
Speak to Joshua the high priest
Set crowns upon the head of Joshua
questions.correctAnswer: Look and see the four chariots
questions.explanation: The first event is Zechariah turning and looking to see the four chariots as described in Zechariah 6:1, before the instructions about making crowns or speaking to Joshua.

medium.title: Zechariah Chapter 6 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Zechariah Chapter 6 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Zechariah 6:6, which direction do the black horses go?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:6 states that the black horses go forth into the north country, followed by the white horses going after them, and the grisled horses going toward the south country.

questions.question: What instruction did the angel give regarding the bay horses in Zechariah 6:7?
options: To walk to and fro through the earth
To remain stationary between the mountains
To go only to the north country
questions.correctAnswer: To walk to and fro through the earth
questions.explanation: In Zechariah 6:7, the angel commands the bay horses to 'walk to and fro through the earth,' and they obey this command.

questions.question: How did the horses going toward the north country affect God's spirit according to Zechariah 6:8?
options: They quieted His spirit in the north country
They had no effect on His spirit
They caused His spirit to depart
questions.correctAnswer: They quieted His spirit in the north country
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:8 reveals that the horses going toward the north country quieted God's spirit there, showing a calming or settling effect.

questions.question: Who are the captives mentioned in Zechariah 6:10 from whom Zechariah is told to take?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 instructs Zechariah to take Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, who are captives come from Babylon, emphasizing their role in the following actions.

questions.question: What was Zechariah commanded to do with silver and gold in Zechariah 6:11?
options: Make crowns and set them upon Joshua the high priest's head
questions.correctAnswer: Make crowns and set them upon Joshua the high priest's head
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:11 directs using silver and gold to make crowns and place them on Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, symbolizing honor and authority.

questions.question: How does Zechariah 6:12 describe 'The BRANCH' and his role?
options: He will grow up, build the temple, and be a priest upon his throne
He will be a mighty warrior conquering nations
He will gather the exiles in the wilderness
questions.correctAnswer: He will grow up, build the temple, and be a priest upon his throne
questions.explanation: Verse 12 reveals that The BRANCH will grow up from his place, build the temple of the Lord, and serve as a priest on his throne, combining kingly and priestly roles.

questions.question: What is the significance of the crowns mentioned in Zechariah 6:14?
options: They serve as a memorial in the temple of the LORD
They are to be given to the poor
They symbolize the end of captivity
questions.correctAnswer: They serve as a memorial in the temple of the LORD
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:14 states the crowns are for Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen as a memorial in the temple, commemorating their roles and God's work through them.

questions.question: According to Zechariah 6:15, what condition is given for the far off to come and build the temple?
options: Diligent obedience to the voice of the LORD your God
questions.correctAnswer: Diligent obedience to the voice of the LORD your God
questions.explanation: Verse 15 connects the coming of those far off to build the temple with the condition of diligent obedience to God's voice, emphasizing faithfulness as key.

questions.question: What does the passage in Zechariah 6:6-7 teach us about God's sovereign control over the earth?
options: God sends the four spirits (horses) to different parts of the earth to execute His will
The horses act independently without God's command
The horses only stay within the mountains
The horses bring destruction without purpose
questions.correctAnswer: God sends the four spirits (horses) to different parts of the earth to execute His will
questions.explanation: Verses 6 and 7 describe the four horses as spirits going to north, south, and to walk through the earth by God's command, illustrating His sovereign governance.

questions.question: How does Zechariah 6:8-9 illustrate the relationship between God's Spirit and His word through the prophet?
options: God's Spirit is calmed by the actions of the horses, then His word comes to Zechariah
God's Spirit ignores earthly events and does not communicate
The prophet receives no word after the Spirit is quieted
The Spirit and word operate separately without connection
questions.correctAnswer: God's Spirit is calmed by the actions of the horses, then His word comes to Zechariah
questions.explanation: Verse 8 shows the Spirit is quieted by the horses going north, and verse 9 follows with the word of the LORD coming to Zechariah, linking Spirit activity and prophetic communication.

questions.question: What biblical virtue does the instruction in Zechariah 6:10-11 about making crowns and setting them on Joshua teach us?
options: Honoring and recognizing God's appointed leaders
Ignoring leadership and focusing on self
Seeking earthly power for personal gain
questions.correctAnswer: Honoring and recognizing God's appointed leaders
questions.explanation: Verses 10-11 show God commanding honor on Joshua the high priest through crowns, teaching respect and recognition for God-ordained authority.

questions.question: A believer struggles with doubt about God’s plans for leadership and rebuilding the community. Based on Zechariah 6:12-13, what truth applies?
options: God raises a leader (The Branch) who will build the temple and bring peace as both priest and ruler
Leadership is irrelevant to God’s plans
The temple will never be rebuilt
Peace comes only through human effort without divine help
questions.correctAnswer: God raises a leader (The Branch) who will build the temple and bring peace as both priest and ruler
questions.explanation: Verses 12-13 promise that The Branch will build the temple, bear glory, rule on the throne, and serve as priest, bringing peace, encouraging faith in God's providence.

questions.question: True or False: According to Zechariah 6:7, the bay horses refused to obey the angel's command to walk to and fro through the earth.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:7 states that the bay horses sought to go and walk to and fro through the earth, and they did so after being commanded, showing obedience rather than refusal.

questions.question: True or False: Zechariah 6:15 teaches that obedience to God’s voice is necessary for the fulfillment of His promises.
questions.explanation: Verse 15 clearly states that the fulfillment of the promise for those far off to come and build rests on diligent obedience to the LORD’s voice.

questions.question: True or False: Zechariah 6:14 indicates that the crowns will be forgotten and have no lasting significance.
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says the crowns will be a memorial in the temple of the LORD, indicating lasting remembrance and significance, not forgetting.

hard.title: Zechariah Chapter 6 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Zechariah Chapter 6.

questions.question: Who is crowned with silver and gold crowns in Zechariah 6?
options: Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest
questions.correctAnswer: Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:11 commands to make crowns of silver and gold and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, indicating he is the one crowned.

questions.question: What title is given to the man named in Zechariah 6:12 who will build the temple of the LORD?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:12 specifically names the man as 'The Branch' who will grow up and build the temple of the LORD.

questions.question: According to Zechariah 6:13, what unique dual role will The Branch hold?
options: He will be both priest and king
He will be prophet and judge
He will be a warrior and priest
He will be a king and prophet
questions.correctAnswer: He will be both priest and king
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:13 states The Branch shall sit and rule upon his throne as king and also be a priest upon his throne, showing a unique combination of roles.

questions.question: Which four individuals are commemorated with crowns as a memorial in the temple according to Zechariah 6?
options: Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen the son of Zephaniah
questions.correctAnswer: Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen the son of Zephaniah
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:14 names these four individuals who receive crowns as a memorial in the temple of the LORD.

questions.question: According to Zechariah 6:15, what condition must be met for the distant ones to come and build the temple?
options: They must diligently obey the voice of the LORD their God
They must bring offerings of silver and gold
They must first send messengers to Jerusalem
They must fast and pray for seven days
questions.correctAnswer: They must diligently obey the voice of the LORD their God
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:15 clearly states that the rebuilding by those far off will happen if they diligently obey the voice of the LORD their God.

questions.question: Which other Old Testament passage also uses the title 'The Branch' to refer to a future Davidic figure?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 23:5 uses 'The Branch' as a messianic title for a righteous king from David's line, connecting with Zechariah 6:12's use of the same title.

questions.question: What literary device is used in Zechariah 6:13 when it says The Branch will bear the glory and be both priest and king, establishing peace between them?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:13 uses chiasm by presenting The Branch's dual role (priest and king) with the counsel of peace between them, highlighting a literary parallel structure.

questions.question: What is the significance of the crowns made of silver and gold in Zechariah 6:11 within the ancient Near Eastern context?
options: They symbolize authority and honor bestowed upon leaders
They were common decorative items with no symbolism
They were offerings to pagan gods
questions.correctAnswer: They symbolize authority and honor bestowed upon leaders
questions.explanation: In the ancient Near East, crowns of precious metals symbolized royal authority and honor, so the crowns in Zechariah 6:11 signify divine appointment and leadership.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage echoes the theme of The Branch as a priest-king in Zechariah 6?
questions.explanation: Hebrews 7:1-3 discusses Melchizedek as both king and priest, echoing the priest-king typology of The Branch in Zechariah 6:13.

questions.question: Who are the individuals named in Zechariah 6:10 who returned from Babylonian captivity?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:10 names Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah as those from captivity who come from Babylon.

questions.question: True or False: The crowns mentioned in Zechariah 6:14 are placed on Joshua the high priest's head.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:14 states the crowns are for Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen as a memorial in the temple, not placed on Joshua's head who was crowned earlier in verse 11.

questions.question: True or False: Zechariah 6:15 promises that those far off will build the temple if they obey the LORD's voice diligently.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:15 affirms that distant people will come to build the temple upon diligent obedience to God's voice.

questions.question: What is the Hebrew meaning of the word 'Branch' (Hebrew: Tsemach) as used in Zechariah 6:12?
options: A sprout or shoot symbolizing new growth and hope
questions.correctAnswer: A sprout or shoot symbolizing new growth and hope
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word 'Tsemach' means a sprout or shoot, symbolizing new life and hope, which fits the messianic figure in Zechariah 6:12.

questions.question: According to Zechariah 6:13, what will be the nature of the counsel between the priest and king roles of The Branch?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:13 states 'the counsel of peace shall be between them both,' indicating a peaceful union of priestly and kingly authority.

questions.question: Which prophecy in the Old Testament foretells that distant nations will assist in the rebuilding of the temple, similar to Zechariah 6:15?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:2 predicts all nations coming to the mountain of the LORD, reflecting the theme in Zechariah 6:15 of distant peoples coming to build the temple.

theological.title: Zechariah Chapter 6 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Zechariah Chapter 6 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What color horses were in the first chariot described in Zechariah 6?
questions.explanation: The first chariot had red horses, as stated in Zechariah 6:2.

questions.question: What do the four chariots represent according to the angel's explanation?
options: The four spirits of the heavens
The four gifts of the Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: The four spirits of the heavens
questions.explanation: The angel explains that these are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth, as stated in Zechariah 6:5.

questions.question: Which direction do the black horses go according to the vision?
questions.explanation: The black horses go forth into the north country, as mentioned in Zechariah 6:6.

questions.question: What did the bay horses seek to do according to the text?
options: Walk to and fro through the earth
questions.correctAnswer: Walk to and fro through the earth
questions.explanation: The bay went forth and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth, as stated in Zechariah 6:7.

questions.question: What was the purpose of the crowns to be made from silver and gold?
options: To place upon Joshua the high priest's head
To be given to the kings
questions.correctAnswer: To place upon Joshua the high priest's head
questions.explanation: The crowns were to be set upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, as instructed in Zechariah 6:11.

questions.question: Which title is given to the man who will build the temple of the Lord?
questions.explanation: The man whose name is The Branch will grow up out of his place and build the temple of the Lord, as stated in Zechariah 6:12.

questions.question: According to Zechariah 6, who will bear the glory and sit on a throne?
questions.explanation: The Branch shall bear the glory and sit and rule upon his throne, as indicated in Zechariah 6:13.

questions.question: What is said to be a memorial in the temple of the Lord?
questions.explanation: The crowns shall be for a memorial in the temple of the Lord, as stated in Zechariah 6:14.

questions.question: What will happen if the people diligently obey the voice of the Lord their God?
options: They will build the temple of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: They will build the temple of the Lord
questions.explanation: It will come to pass that they shall build in the temple of the Lord if they diligently obey the voice of the Lord their God, as mentioned in Zechariah 6:15.

questions.question: What attribute of God is emphasized by His sovereignty over the spirits of the heavens?
questions.explanation: God's sovereignty is emphasized as He commands the four spirits of the heavens to go forth, as stated in Zechariah 6:5.

questions.question: How does Zechariah 6 connect to the broader narrative of redemption in Scripture?
options: It shows the importance of sacrifice
It prophesies the coming of the Messiah
questions.correctAnswer: It prophesies the coming of the Messiah
questions.explanation: The mention of The Branch in Zechariah 6:12, who will build the temple, is a significant foreshadowing of the coming Messiah.

questions.question: What doctrinal insight is conveyed by the relationship between the high priest and the king as seen in Zechariah 6:13?
options: The separation of church and state
The unity of priesthood and kingship
questions.correctAnswer: The unity of priesthood and kingship
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:13 illustrates the unity of priesthood and kingship as The Branch will be both a priest upon his throne and a ruler.

questions.question: What combined teaching do verses 10 and 11 convey about the restoration of God's people?
options: The importance of wealth in worship
God's desire for physical restoration and leadership
questions.correctAnswer: God's desire for physical restoration and leadership
questions.explanation: Verses 10 and 11 combined convey God's desire to restore His people physically through leadership in the form of Joshua the high priest, as he is crowned.

questions.question: What does Zechariah 6:8 teach about the peace that comes from God?
options: It brings quietness to the spirit
It is based on human effort
questions.correctAnswer: It brings quietness to the spirit
questions.explanation: Zechariah 6:8 indicates that the spirits going to the north country have quieted God's spirit, suggesting that divine peace brings tranquility.

questions.question: What sceptics claim regarding the prophecy in Zechariah 6:12-13, and what does it actually teach?
options: Christ cannot be both priest and king
questions.correctAnswer: Christ cannot be both priest and king
questions.explanation: Sceptics claim Christ cannot fulfill both roles, but Zechariah 6:12-13 explicitly teaches that The Branch will be both a priest and a king, affirming His dual role in the messianic prophecy.
